I've updated the knowledge base with Pree's correction. The new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47. I withdrew the earlier Dock 23 entry and noted why: Pree said they read the wrong line. The new entry is credited to their correction message and mentions the entry it replaces. The Dock 23 entry is no longer active, but its audit trail is kept.

I replied in a thread on Pree's message in #central-team: "Thanks Pree, updated: the new inbound lane at Marrow Agrisupply is at Gate 47. I've withdrawn the earlier Dock 23 note."

As far as I know, Gate 47 is now the only active entry about this lane. Dock 23 was the only earlier one, and I withdrew it.
